“Trajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents”

The screenshot’s community section also references “all five checkpoints and the 34,772-interaction candidate pool” being released, which supports the response’s claim.

The response therefore answers all parts of the task with details consistent with the screenshot and additional believable supporting information.
